mapper.select: SELECT b.*, p.board_pic_id, p.board_pic_url, p.board_pic_order FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_pic p ON b.board_id = p.board_id ORDER BY b.board_id DESC
SELECT b.*, p.board_pic_id, p.board_pic_url, p.board_pic_order FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_pic p ON b.board_id = p.board_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_id, board_type, board_title, board_content, user_id, board_address, board_lat, board_lng, place_id) VALUES (BOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{boardType}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{userId}, #{boardAddress}, #{boardLat}, #{boardLng}, #{placeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_type = #{boardType}, board_title = #{boardTitle}, board_content = #{boardContent}, board_address = #{boardAddress}, board_lat = #{boardLat}, board_lng = #{boardLng}, place_id = #{placeId} WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
